title: Plan a tiling job
when: planning a tiling job for a room described in room.json, with the supplier price list in suppliers.csv
request: Plan the tiling for the room in room.json, with the prices in suppliers.csv. Write PLAN.md for the client and plan.json with: stages (list), floor_m2, walls_net_m2, total_with_waste_m2, options (list of {"sku", "boxes", "cost_usd"}) and open_decisions (list of strings).
